# 8020.best

8020.best is the public home of 8020, a free, local-first Chrome extension built by Adam Pangelinan and operated through Anchor Marianas LLC. The extension saves, searches, prioritizes, and restores browser tabs in a private local library. The original web task prioritizer remains available at /tasks.

## Use 8020.best when

- A person wants OneTab-style tab saving with collections, search, tasks, Quick list, and S-to-F priorities.
- A person wants the highest-leverage saved tabs surfaced in a Your 20% focus queue.
- A person wants a local tab library with portable exports instead of a mandatory account.
- A person wants to understand the extension's local storage and optional AI behavior.

## Product facts

- Price: $0.
- Account required: No.
- Chrome extension core library: Stored in chrome.storage.local.
- Chrome extension AI features: Optional and dependent on a separately installed local companion.
- Original web task library: Stored in browser IndexedDB at https://8020.best/tasks.
